headlines.headline: DUKE HEADLINES PRESEASON POWER RANKINGS AS 2026-27 SLATE TAKES SHAPE
headlines.detail: Duke topped Andy Katz's first Power 44 rankings for the 2026-27 season, and the Big East released its full conference schedule. The early buzz comes five months after Michigan beat UConn for the 2026 national title at Lucas Oil Stadium.

headlines.headline: SIXERS ENTER SEASON WITH FOUR 'SUPER-USERS' AFTER BROWN, LEBRON MOVES
headlines.detail: Philadelphia traded for Jaylen Brown this offseason, then landed LeBron James in free agency three weeks later, giving the Sixers four players with career usage rates above 25% alongside Joel Embiid and Tyrese Maxey. Elsewhere, Pacers star Tyrese Haliburton continues a gradual return from the Achilles tear he suffered in Game 7 of the 2025 Finals.

headlines.headline: BILLS OPEN NEW STADIUM HOSTING LIONS IN WEEK 2 THURSDAY NIGHT SHOWCASE
headlines.detail: Buffalo christens its new stadium against Detroit on Thursday Night Football to open Week 2, after a Week 1 slate in which the Cardinals upset the Chargers on the road and the Jets beat the Titans. The Bears-Panthers opener alone produced 96 combined points.

headlines.headline: OREGON, OKLAHOMA UPSETS SCRAMBLE COLLEGE FOOTBALL PLAYOFF PICTURE
headlines.detail: Oregon lost 39-31 at Oklahoma State and No. 11 Oklahoma fell 17-10 to Michigan in Week 2, upending playoff projections after Oregon had been viewed as a near-lock contender. Oregon still has to play at USC and Ohio State this season.
